stateKeys.name: reason
stateKeys.type: string, why this target ended without a verified change ('' otherwise)

dataFields.changed: boolean, false when the file did not need the change

specialRules.name: a-file-nobody-had-to-change-is-skipped-not-verified
specialRules.note: CHANGE_APPLIED with changed:false ends the target in 'skipped'. Running a test suite for a file that was never touched wastes the crew's time and would report a pass that means nothing.

specialRules.name: stale-completions-reject
specialRules.note: A report arriving in a state that does not await it is an observable rejection (post == pre), never a fault. Several sessions share these targets, so a duplicate report or one that arrives after another actor moved the target on is an ordinary event.
